bible_refs.note: Quoted: those who have wives as not having them.

pass_a_gloss: And the one chewing the pascha in marriage too will gird his loin; for blessed those having wives as not having, the apostle has said.
pass_b_english: And even the one who chews the Passover in marriage will gird his loin. For blessed are those who have wives as not having them, the apostle has said (1 Corinthians 7:29).
source_text: Καὶ ὁ ἐν γάμῳ δὲ τὸ πάσχα τρώγων τὴν ὀσφὺν αὐτοῦ περιζώσεται· μακάριοι γὰρ οἱ ἔχοντες|| γυναῖκας ὡς {οἱ} μὴ ἔχοντες, ὁ ἀπόστολος εἴρηκεν.
